title: Bug: fib/test_fib.py test_vxlan_hash [ipv6-*] failed
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

test_vxlan_hash failed when the outer packet is IPv6.
The original PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/15285 uses IPv4 outer_dst_ip for get_src_and_exp_ports even for IPv6 cases.
IPv4 and IPv6 default routes can contain different ports.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run fib/test_fib.py test_vxlan_hash [ipv6-*], it will fail if IPv4 and IPv6 default routes contain different ports.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test should pass and IPv6 outer_dst_ip should be used in get_src_and_exp_ports.
